changelog:
Initial release of douyin-scraper-api.

- Provides access to 27 Douyin (Chinese TikTok) data endpoints via Scavio API, including videos, user profiles, comments, hashtags, music, live rooms, trending, and search.
- Delivers structured JSON responses for each data type.
- Search endpoints require 10 credits per call; all others cost 1 credit.
- Includes endpoints to resolve share/user links and extract IDs.
- Offers pagination and usage guardrails for responsible use.
- Includes setup instructions with API key and practical usage code examples.
display_name: Douyin API - Videos, Creators, Comments, Search
summary: Pull Douyin videos, user profiles and feeds, comments, hashtags, music, live rooms, the hot-search board, and keyword search across videos, users, music, live and hashtags. 27 endpoints, structured JSON.
